description: Bike Rack Locations Downtown Pittsburgh is a dataset listed in Western Pennsylvania Regional Data Center (WPRDC), an open data portal, published or maintained by Envision Downtown. List of bike rack locations, capacity and type for Downtown Pittsburgh. Coverage: Allegheny County, Pennsylvania. The portal files it under the publisher Envision Downtown. Its tags are Alternative Transportation, bicycle, bike, bike infrastructure, downtown. It offers 1 resource(s) in CSV. The portal shows 2023-05-21 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Creative Commons Non-Commercial (Any). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support cycling and walking network and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-wprdc-portal.
